_comment: token-bridge config. Lives at the ROOT of the TARGET codebase (not the plugin). The plugin is pointed at a codebase with --repo <path> and loads <path>/token-bridge.config.json. All paths below (source.path, emitTarget) resolve relative to <path>. normalize-to-code never deletes: a live token absent from the parse is reported under 'prunable' (a list) and left in place, because absence is indistinguishable from a parse gap. Removing a token is a manual step in Paper. Both token commands REFUSE to run while fileId is empty — a destructive reconcile must never fall back to whatever Paper file is currently open.

source._comment: The token source. 'path' is a CSS or SCSS file relative to the repo root. 'followImports' (optional, default false) follows @use/@import/@forward from it and parses the whole graph, dependencies first so an importing file's overrides win; Sass partials and directory _index files resolve, sass:* built-ins and remote URLs are skipped, cycles terminate, and an unresolved import warns loudly. 'ref' (optional) reads from a git ref instead of the working tree. 'prefix' filters custom properties AND decides what sync owns — a null prefix owns the entire Paper file.

_primitivePattern_comment: Optional regex overriding how the component-harvest mapper tells a Tier-1 primitive (e.g. --green-500) from a semantic token, for the value-collision tie-break (semantic wins). Default (null) treats a numbered scale step — trailing -<digits> — as primitive. Set it when your primitives are named differently, e.g. '-base$' for --blue-base.

themeConventions._comment: How the dark scope is expressed. Supported: 'data-attribute' (needs attr+value), 'media-query' (needs query), 'class' (needs class), and 'file' (needs path — the dark theme is a SEPARATE FILE whose own document scope carries the overrides; add its 'emitTarget' if you emit). Class matching is class-token-boundary anchored, so '.dark' does not match '.darker'. When MORE THAN ONE is declared, exactly one must set primary:true. The base is a document scope (:root/html/body), never a component selector. Scopes are found at any depth: @layer is transparent, while @media/@supports/@container are conditional.

harvest._comment: Component harvest (code → Paper). 'themeSignal' tells the live-page extractor how the rendered page reports dark: a data-attribute is read off the scope element; a media-query is read via matchMedia; a class is read via classList.contains on <html> or <body> (whole-token, so 'dark' is not satisfied by 'darker'). Shape mirrors the primary convention minus 'primary'. 'batch' lists the components to harvest — each {name, selector, route, trigger?}.
